purpose: Prevent evidence-producing, experimental, correction, admission, exterior-review, routing, and proof-packaging roles from being conflated.

disallowed_promotions.reason: CI success establishes only the workflow's declared scope.
Repository merge is not truth, correctness, or institutional sufficiency.
Exterior review remains bounded observation unless separately authorized.
Commercial relevance is a separate declared dimension.
Indexing and packaging admission are separate acts.
Corrections are prospective successors and preserve negative evidence.
Live execution requires a separate exact-scope authorization.
Buyer interest does not establish operational effectiveness or readiness.

permitted_before_finished_proof: Design a bounded demonstration or proof-of-value path.
State required controls and evidence before an offer becomes active.
prohibited_before_finished_proof: Represent the capability as production validated.
Represent expected savings or risk reduction as realized.
Represent a research candidate as a finished client proof.
Represent institutional interest as endorsement or procurement approval.
active_production_offer_requires: privacy, security, retention, rollback, and incident controls

sequence_rule: Dependencies may reference only earlier proof identifiers in the same registry.
pr_purpose_rule: Every pull request in source_pr_purpose_registry must have one primary role and at least one served proof identifier; assignment creates no standing.
execution_rule: No portfolio record may authorize execution or provider calls.
